purpose: Replace the non-frequency per-voxel coverage components before any validation or frontier promotion.

legacy_gate.coverage68_coverage95: retain as diagnostic only; remove from promotion decision
legacy_gate.reason: single-member spatial spread over posterior draws is not frequentist coverage over independent truth seeds

proposed_primary_coverage_gate.unit: each latent coefficient mode across independent development truth seeds
proposed_primary_coverage_gate.multiple_testing_correction: Bonferroni over 8 modes x 2 interval levels
proposed_primary_coverage_gate.acceptance_construction: central binomial quantiles at p=target, n=64, alpha=0.003125

directional_overcoverage_guard.statistic: per-seed mean of eight mode coverage indicators

power_sensitivity.reason: the eight modes are correlated within each truth seed; the adopted unit is the seed-cluster bootstrap, so an independent-pair n=512 power number is not a valid gate calibration
power_sensitivity.required_followup: If power is needed, preregister a seed-cluster simulation at explicit seed counts (for example 64 and 256) and report the complete data-generating and resampling unit

D_arm_stress_stratum.role: diagnostic stress report; no standalone promotion claim at n=16

required_before_adoption: freeze this contract before touching sealed validation seeds
do not execute the mark-side misspecification arm unless a new information-adequacy calculation justifies it
